facts.business: Western Overseas Study Abroad Limited provides international mobility solutions including language and test preparation (IELTS, PTE, TOEFL, etc.), foreign language training, overseas education advisory, immigration consultancy, permanent residency and visa services, and international manpower recruitment.

auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matter regarding deferment of advertisement, online promotion and Research & Development expenditure and amortization thereof over future periods based on management estimates of future economic benefits.

key_risks: Frequent changes in visa and immigration regulations
Dependence on customer sentiment and economic conditions
Regulatory risk arising from changes in immigration laws, student visa norms and admission requirements
Market risk due to reduced demand caused by economic slowdown, geopolitical developments or policy restrictions
Reputation risk from poor customer experience, service deficiencies or misinformation
